statement._text: And so we had to resort to violence...May they find their ancestors and rest in peace...
I’m glad we could avoid bloodshed. It’s a shame that they felt they had to leave, but such is their choice.
You have a silver tongue, [PlayerName]. I’m impressed that you managed to make them consider reason again. We could use someone like you to fill the gap that Zephyrien left behind!
And so we had to resort to violence...May they find their ancestors and rest in peace...

They're too far gone for me to reason with...I'm worried they might become violent. We've been discussing their unfounded beliefs for hours now. If you can convince them, please, do it. I don't want bloodshed here today.
Greetings. I hope you’re well!
I look forward to working with you, pilgrim. May Elatt welcome you.
At attention Zephyrien, we have a guest! What do you need from us?
I'm considering joining the Holy Mission, actually.
Let me take a look at you... I see potential there, but it's very much a gem in the rough. What do you think, Zephyrien?
I can definitely tell you’ve got the spirit for it, but you need discipline if you're going to make it in the martial path of the Holy Mission.
You're both Champions? I have trouble telling you both apart with that armor.
What is serving Elatt like?
I have that discipline potion for you, Zephyrien.
Well, nice meeting you both.
That's easy. I'm the one of us who actually bothers to wear the helmet. Also, I'm the one with the warhammer. It's more than just a weapon to kill things with, it's a tool to rebuild what we've lost.

And I happen to believe that if you have to get into a fight, you don't go armed with a stick. You use maximum force to remove whatever passes for the threat's head, and resolve the problem right there.
What is serving Elatt like?
Well, nice meeting you both.
Well, nice meeting you both.
It's amazing. Every day, we make a difference in people's lives, carrying the flame of Elatt in our hearts and minds. Bearing some small portion of a god's power in your very being is incredible.

It's also very dangerous. You will need to lay your life on the line daily if you serve Elatt. It's not a job for the faint of heart. Following the three pillars of our teachings requires a great deal of self-sacrifice.
You will likely be following the missionary's path. Your tasks will take you to places far and wide, to deal with conflicts that need to be resolved.
And what do Champions do?

Elatt's Champions are the pinnacle of the missionary's path. We are blessed with great strength, which we use to crush any who would disturb the peace. Whether that's destroying invading Scourge monsters, or punishing bandits on a kidnapping spree.

If you're thinking of replacing one of us, think again. Elatt may be powerful, but he's not omnipotent. He can only provide the raw energy needed for two champions at any given time. And neither of us has any intention of retiring anytime soon.
Nice to meet you, Pilgrim. I hope our paths cross again sometime.

Perfect, this'll be a big help. I sometimes feel like can't even make it through the day without at least one of these!

Hey, by way of thanks, do you want to know how to make a Warrior's Elixir? You just need to put Larva eggs, Krimp nuts, Crystal powder and water into an alchemy set and steam it! It’s a real help when you’re preparing for a big fight.
Discipline...Right, that reminds me! I need a discipline potion. My stocks are low and I need those to make use of my more powerful techniques. If you could bring me one, I'd be in your debt.
If you can’t find one for me, it’s pretty easy to brew. You just need some Livweedi and water and an alchemy set. I don't care if you brew it or buy it, personally.
Greetings. I hope you’re well!
I’m afraid I’m quite busy, perhaps some other time.
Farewell.
I want to train with you.

Hmm...If you favor the two-handed mace, I can teach you the Juggernaut Strike. It’s a slow, but immensely powerful strike that has helped me many times against slow, durable foes. If you’ll donate 50 silvers to the “Temple cleanup” fund, I’ll teach you.
Deal, here’s your money.
No, thanks.
Alright, first take a firm stance, plant your feet and pull your mace back. Then once all your weight is on your back foot swing all that weight into a single upwards motion. Here, let me show you...
-Gah! Good hit! You've got a good handle on that skill now! Remember, it takes time to pull off. Be sure your blow will connect before you use it!
